gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Loose, wobbly and hand-made. Shantell Sans draws every stem and tail like rope, while ZCOOL XiaoWei tapers gently, more like a sharpened pencil line, so the two feel playful against tidy.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi stays low and quiet. Underdog's bent-straw lines and horseshoe-wide curves give the pair its strongest quality: a loud, rubbery heading sitting over a small-voiced, approachable sans-serif.
